The designer should specify if the tolerance includes the plating thickness or add a pre-plate size with plating allowance.","recommended_correction":"Clarify on the drawing whether the ±0.02 tolerance on D11 is before or after plating, and adjust the nominal or tolerance to account for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
